items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Not because your hair is Red. Uh, Red Allen.

ctx.x: Yeah. Everybody asks me the same thing. Uh, uh, in, in the black culture, anybody whose skin is light, you can have black hair, you can have blonde hair, green hair. Right. If you're, color, skin color is light. Right. They call you Red. Okay. Not because your hair is Red. Uh, Red Allen. Uh, you know, you walk into a place and somebody don't, who wouldn't know you, and if they, if if they wanted to get your attention, hey Red, come here. Okay. The same way, like at, at one time, they don't do it as much or they…
Now, when, when people started calling you Red, what, how'd you feel? It was okay. Okay with you?
